defects.justification: The error from deleting the previous session on re-login is discarded (`_ = a.deleteSession(...)`), so if the delete fails the old session token stays valid in the database with nothing logged, even though the code says it rotates sessions.

golang.org/x/oauth2 v0.24.0 predates the fix for CVE-2025-22868 (unbounded memory in the jws token parser, fixed in v0.27.0). The app does not call jws, so the risk is low, but the pinned version is a known-vulnerable release.
